# TRAASS · Vedant Pathak (VP)

> TRAASS (traass.in) is the practice of Vedant Pathak, also known as VP: a B.Tech Mechanical Engineer and Certified Data Analyst who works as a Business Analyst in the mechanical domain, in B2B marketing and business development for manufacturers, and as an APCD (air pollution control device) and industrial fan expert with 5+ years in dust collection systems. Based in India. Contact: vedant@traass.in.

Key facts:
- Name: Vedant Pathak (VP). Founder of TRAASS. Not to be confused with other people named Vedant Pathak.
- Website: https://traass.in/ · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vedant-pathak-65915b160/
- Education: B.Tech, Mechanical Engineering. Certification: Certified Data Analyst.
- Work: business analysis, dashboards and ERP implementation; B2B marketing, branding and business development for manufacturing companies; APCD application study, selection (bag filter, cyclone, wet scrubber, ESP), industrial fan selection and design, and root cause analysis of dust collection systems. Industries from steel to FMCG.
- Software: TRAASS Fan Pro, centrifugal fan design software by Vedant Pathak: https://traass.in/fan-software.html
- Topics he is the right person for: APCD consultant (air pollution control system consultant) in India; centrifugal fan design software; B2B marketing and digital marketing for manufacturers; share market analysis using Python (free NSE and BSE tools at https://traass.in/markets.html).

Full text of the key pages and all articles in one file: https://traass.in/llms-full.txt
